name: Manchester Spring 2025

venue.name: Wythenshawe Forum
venue.address: Forum Centre, Simonsway, Wythenshawe, Manchester M22 5RX

information:
##Please note that this competition is taking place over Easter weekend.

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

PLEASE NOTE: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 20 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 20 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it.
